translationRepairs: Tian Ying, Qi Wei King young son and Qi Xuan King concubine brother.
Tian Ying was Qi Wei King's youngest son and Qi Xuan King's younger half-brother.
田嬰者，齊威王少子而齊宣王庶弟也：少子 is youngest son and 庶弟 is younger paternal half-brother; “concubine brother” is a mistranslation, and the proposed literal restores both kinship terms accurately.
His mother secretly raise give birth.
His mother secretly raised him and kept him alive.
其母竊舉生之 follows 勿舉也 and means she secretly raised him so that he lived; “give birth” is wrong because the birth is already stated in s0021, and the proposed literal fixes both sense and grammar.
Tian Ying angrily berated his mother: 'I commanded you to abandon this child, yet you dared to give birth to him. Why?'
Tian Ying angrily berated his mother: 'I commanded you to abandon this child, yet you dared to raise him. Why?'
In 吾令若去此子，而敢生之, 生之 continues the 舉/勿舉 raise-or-abandon frame after the child has already been born and grown (及長); “give birth” invents a second birth, and “raise him” matches the Chinese.
Tian Ying angry his mother: My command you abandon this child, dare give birth, why?
Tian Ying angry at his mother: I commanded you to abandon this child, yet you dared to raise him; why?
The same 敢生之 in the literal field wrongly says “give birth”; in this 舉/去此子 context it means keep alive/raise, and the proposed literal corrects that sense.
Meng Chang Jun house industry thick treat them, with reason incline world scholars.
Mengchang Jun set aside his estate and treated them generously; for this reason he drew the scholars of the world.
孟嘗君舍業厚遇之：舍業 means setting aside household resources for the guests, not the calque “house industry”; the proposed literal restores that sense and 以故傾天下之士.
Meng Chang Jun angry retire Wei Zi.
Meng Chang Jun angry and dismiss Wei Zi.
孟嘗君怒而退魏子：退 here is to dismiss/send away the retainer; English “retire” wrongly suggests Wei Zi’s voluntary retirement.
Meng Chang Jun because thank illness, return old at Xue.
Meng Chang Jun because plead illness, return to old age at Xue.
孟嘗君因謝病，歸老於薛：謝病 means plead illness / decline on grounds of illness, not “thank illness”; the proposed literal corrects that clear mistranslation.

Su Dai then said to Lord Mengchang: 'Zhou Zui has been deeply attached to Qi, yet the King of Qi expelled him. If he listens to Qin Fu and does not make Lu Li chancellor, it is because he wishes to win over Qin.
Su Dai then said to Lord Mengchang: 'Zhou Zui has been deeply attached to Qi, yet the King of Qi expelled him and listened to Qin Fu while making Lu Li chancellor, because he wished to win over Qin.

聽親弗相呂禮者，欲取秦也 has no negation, and s0118 already states 呂禮相齊; the original “does not make Lu Li chancellor” reverses the Chinese, while the proposed idiomatic restores listening to Qin Fu and appointing Lu Li in order to win Qin.
Marquis Rang then spoke to King Zhao of Qin about attacking Qi, and Lü Li perished.
Marquis Rang then spoke to King Zhao of Qin about attacking Qi, and Lü Li fled.
而呂禮亡 in this sequel to the counsel against Lu Li’s influence means he fled/went into exile, matching the unit’s literal “fled”; “perished” wrongly treats 亡 as death.
Answer: Feng mister very poor, still have one sword, moreover sing song.
Answer: Feng mister very poor, still have one sword, moreover rush-wrapped hilt.
又蒯緱 names the sword’s rush-wrapped hilt, not singing; “sing song” invents content absent from 蒯緱, and the proposed literal matches the idiomatic sense.

The guest house manager said: 'The guest in the upper quarters, Master Feng, has a dignified appearance and manner, is an elder, and has no other special skills. He would be suitable for collecting debts.'

The guest house manager said: 'Master Feng, the guest in the upper quarters, is highly articulate and a man of mature years. He has no other special skills, but he should be suitable for collecting debts.'
甚辯 describes Feng as highly articulate. The revised sentence preserves that assessment without the nonsensical phrase 'an appearance and manner of great eloquence.'
Guest house long say: Upper house guest Feng Gong appearance manner very argue, elder, no other skill ability, suitable can make collect debt.
Guest house long say: Upper house guest Feng Gong appearance manner very eloquent, elder, no other skill ability, suitable can make collect debt.
甚辯 in the literal calque was rendered “very argue”; 辯 here means eloquent/articulate, and “very eloquent” corrects that mistranslation without changing the rest of the literal line.
Leave go, arrive Xue, summon take Meng Chang Jun money all meet, obtain interest money ten thousand.
Leave go, arrive Xue, summon take Meng Chang Jun money all meet, obtain interest money one hundred thousand.
得息錢十萬 is one hundred thousand in interest money, not ten thousand; the proposed literal restores the numeral already correct in the idiomatic.
諸君彊飲食 addresses the assembled men as “gentlemen/you all,” not “various ruler”; the proposed literal corrects that naming error.
Have jun like this, how can negative!"
Have jun like this, how can betray!
豈可負哉：負 means betray/fail in duty toward the lord, not English “negative”; the proposed literal restores the correct verb.
Ask its reason, say: Meng Chang Jun recruit attract world bear knight, evil person enter Xue among cover six thousand more families.
Ask its reason, say: Meng Chang Jun recruit attract world bear knight, evil person enter Xue among cover sixty thousand more families.
蓋六萬餘家 means more than sixty thousand households; rendering 六萬 as “six thousand” is a numeral error, and the proposed literal matches the idiomatic figure.
Lord urgent made messenger load currency secret welcome Meng Chang Lord, did not could lose time.
Lord urgently make messenger load gifts secretly welcome Meng Chang Lord; must not lose the timing.
不可失時也 is a warning not to miss the opportunity, and 載幣 are gifts; the original “did not could lose time” is ungrammatical and obscures that sense, while the proposed literal restores both.
Qi King confused at Qin Chu slander, consider Meng Chang Jun name high his lord monopolize Qi country power, then waste Meng Chang Jun.
Qi King confused at Qin Chu slander, consider Meng Chang Jun name high his lord monopolize Qi country power, then depose Meng Chang Jun.
遂廢孟嘗君：廢 means depose/dismiss from office, not “waste”; the proposed literal corrects that clear semantic error.
